remarks: Exceptional 2-bedroom 2 bath ranch home in the coveted Ledgebrook Condominium Community.  Just two steps up and into the comfort and convenience of this ground level ranch. This home has an open and inviting living room with a cozy corner fireplace and sliders to a private terrace. There is ample space for a full dining room table and sideboard in the dining area. The eat in kitchen is bright and cheery with white cabinets, stainless fridge and dishwasher. The primary suite boasts an updated full bath and ample closet space including a walk in. The second bedroom also has good closet space and uses the freshly renovated hall bathroom with a walk-in shower. Laundry and a dedicated storage room are in the unit as well as a locked storage space in the nearby building. The Ledgewood complex is known for its scenic beauty and incredibly amenities including a heated pool and spa, a fitness center, library, and walking trails. Ledgebrook is also just minutes away from shopping, dining, public transportation, major highway, medical center and even a public golf course. Don't miss this one!! Note: Homeowner has paid off the special assessment so common charges are only $633!!
